query: I have an attached sprint transcript and two status notes. Turn them into a local static project dashboard with traceable sources, task evidence, and a printable mobile-friendly page.

Produce separate private and public local views of the same project record, close hidden cross-record references, and report only the verification layer actually demonstrated.
Connect our analytics database to a live executive dashboard with interactive revenue charts and hourly refresh.
Summarize this meeting into five bullets and three action items. I do not need files, a dashboard, or a persistent project model.
Create tasks and due dates directly in our hosted project management service from this planning note.

Build a spreadsheet status tracker with formulas, conditional formatting, and a burndown chart from these rows.

Archive last year's generated dashboard folders and remove duplicate local copies after I approve a deletion list.
